thread:
Wanda: opening a small PR to consolidate Security -> Audit Logs migration guidance and SOC 2 wording. Aim: clear language for compliance + a short migration example for SDK users. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1973

Josh: quick +1. engineers asked for an explicit migration example for schema v1 -> v2 so they can update ingest code. nothing too prescriptive about retention defaults here, but include a note to link to the retention section.

Wanda: added a compact before/after example and two micro-snippets (curl + python) in the PR comment. copying key bits here for visibility. please check tone and linter format.

Wanda: BEFORE (v1 event):
```json
{ 'event_id': 'evt_0001', 'user_id': 'user_77', 'email': 'u77@example.com', 'action': 'session.start', 'ts': '2026-06-01T12:00:00Z' }
```

Wanda: AFTER (v2 event):
```json
{ 'id': 'evt_0001', 'actor': { 'id': 'usr_7f', 'email': 'REDACTED' }, 'type': 'session.start', 'timestamp': '2026-06-01T12:00:00Z', 'meta': { 'pseudonymized': true } }
```

Wanda: CURL ingest hint for v2 with retention header:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v2/audit/events \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'X-Redwood-Audit-Retention: 90d' \
  -d '{"id":"evt_0002","actor":{"id":"usr_x"},"type":"api.key.create"}'
```

Wanda: Python SDK migration sketch (pseudo):
```python
# old: client.log(event_id, user_id, action)
# new: client.audit.log({'id': id, 'actor': {'id':...}, 'type': action}, retention='90d', pseudonymize=['actor.email'])
```

Meredith: wording note from legal: avoid asserting certification. suggested: 'Redwood maintains controls aligned with SOC 2 trust service criteria and undergoes independent third-party assessment.' Add a single-sentence customer action: 'For attestation or export procedures, contact support@redwood.com.'

Wanda: added Sara's line and linked the retention defaults section (not included in this PR). also clarified that Dedicated/Private tenants can configure retention per-contract.

Josh: docs-ci-bot flagged a lint warning in the PR: code fence labels must be json/bash/python and no inline comments inside code blocks. removed inline comments and relabeled blocks.

docs-ci-bot: PR check failed  lint: code-blocks missing language tag or use of invalid characters in JSON blocks. See CI: https://ci.redwood.example/1973/logs

Wanda: working on fixes now. will remove single-quote JSON to strict JSON in the final commit and keep examples minimal. planning to merge once CI + legal ack. Thanks all :sparkles:
